# AdGuard CA for NoMount

![AI generated Thumbnail](./docs/thumb.webp)
> Thumbnail generated with GPT 6.1 Sol

A KernelSU module for injecting AdGuard Personal CA with NoMount.

Replaces [adguardcert](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/adguardcert) to `NoMount` based injection.

Tested on Galaxy S25 Edge with [DFRoot](https://github.com/diabl0w/DFRoot) Jailbreak.

## Development

### Build zip

```sh
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run typecheck
bun test
bun run build
```

Export at `dist/adguard-ca-nomount-<version>.zip`.

### Module WebUI

You can check `Personal CA` installed and VFS rule of NoMount Injection in webui.

Use `bun run build` to compile webui.

### GitHub Releases

Before tagging, update `version` and increment `versionCode` in `module/module.prop`, then commit the changes. The tag must match `v<version>`; a mismatch fails the build before publishing.

```sh
git tag v0.1.1
git push origin v0.1.1
```

### Verify

```sh
bun run verify:device
# When multiple devices is connected to adb
bun run verify:device DEVICE_SERIAL
```

Verify checks basic CA cert is installed.
